heading: Saturday, August 23, 2025
topLine: xAI publishes Grok 2.5 weights on Hugging Face.

items.headline: xAI publishes Grok 2.5 weights on Hugging Face
items.summary: Elon Musk announced that xAI had released the weights of Grok 2.5, a model it used in 2024, on Hugging Face (about 500 GB, requiring 8 GPUs). The weights use a custom Grok 2 Community License with usage restrictions; Musk said Grok 3 would be opened in about six months.
